● LIVE WORKING PIPELINE
📷 3D Digital Asset Ingestion • Sy. No. 142/3A
STEP 01 • PROPERTY INTAKE & BILINGUAL OCR

Physical Deed Ingestion & OCR Intelligence

Physical deeds, sale agreements, and revenue extracts are scanned and processed through OJIX’s bilingual OCR engine, trained specifically on historical Kannada and English land records.

⚡ 99.4% Bilingual OCR Accuracy

Accurately transcribes Kannada RTC Form 16, Tippani, MR-21 extracts, and English deeds.

🔒 Cryptographic Hash Lock

Every uploaded document is indexed with SHA-256 fingerprinting to guarantee evidence chain-of-custody.

📑 Automated Entity Extraction

Extracts Survey Number, Hissa, Extent (Acres/Guntas), Khathadar Name, and Registration SRO.

⚠️ Red-Flag Discrepancy Alert

Instantly flags extent mismatches between registered deeds and revenue registers.

Intake Target: Sy. No. 142/3A, Devanahalli Taluk
🏛️ Multi-Registry Cross-Verification • 4 Official Portals
STEP 02 • GOVERNMENT RECORD CITATIONS

Four-Way Government Portal Reconciliation

OJIX cross-references the property identifier against official Karnataka government portals, fetching official revenue records, registered deeds, pre-mutation sketches, and High Court litigation status.

🌾 Bhoomi Portal (Land Records)

RTC Form 16 & MR-21 Mutation Extract verified under Sy. No. 142/3A. Total extent 2A 14G.

📜 Kaveri 2.0 (Registration)

Registered Sale Deed #4821 and 30-Year Nil Encumbrance Certificate (Form 15) confirmed clear.

📐 Mojini SSLR (Survey)

11E Pre-Mutation Cadastral Sketch & boundary Tippani stone lock matched to field survey.

⚖️ Karnataka High Court

Attara Kacheri judicial database scanned for pending OS civil suits, stay orders, or writ petitions: 0 Disputes.

● 4/4 CITATIONS ATTACHED • 100% PROVENANCE

STEP 03 • GIS & SPATIAL RISK ANALYSIS

Cadastral Geometry Lock & Environmental Buffer Audit

The parcel boundary is locked to high-resolution satellite imagery and audited against BDA/BMRDA Master Plans, NGT buffer mandates, Rajakaluve storm drains, and lake setbacks.

✓ 0m Conflict: Parcel boundary sits safely beyond the natural storm drain buffer line.

🏞️ Lake 30m NGT Setback

✓ 110m Clearance: Fully compliant with National Green Tribunal environmental setbacks.

🛣️ 45m CDP Master Plan Road

✓ Road ROW Conforming: Direct access to planned 45m Zonal Master Plan road corridor.

🏗️ CDP Zoning Verification

✓ Hi-Tech Industrial: Permitted for commercial, logistics, and tech park development.

✓ Cadastre Polygon ✓ Rajakaluve 50m ✓ Lake Setback 30m ✓ 45m Road Corridor

📜 30-Year Unbroken Chain of Title • 1994 - 2024
STEP 04 • TITLE CHAIN & LINEAGE REVIEW

30-Year Unbroken Historical Chain of Title

OJIX reconstructs the historical title lineage across ancestral partition deeds, revenue mutations, and registered transfers, checking for minor rights, succession claims, and mortgage charges.

1994 • Ancestral Partition Deed

Family partition registered under Doc #1204/1994, granting clear title to branch lineage.

2004 • Revenue Mutation Extract

MR-21/2004-05 officially sanctioned by Village Accountant and Tahsildar with public notice.

2014 • Registered Sale Deed

Doc #3120/2014 registered at Devanahalli SRO with full consideration and stamp receipt.

2024 • 30-Yr Nil Encumbrance

Form 15 issued with zero outstanding bank mortgages, attachments, or tax liens.

● TITLE INTEGRITY: 98.4% (MARKETABLE & CLEAR)
